title: My tracker counted two heartbeats ⌚
style_prompt: dark blue cinematic night, faceless silhouette, fog, minimal interior, no text, no watermark
hook_text: At 5:12 in the morning my fitness tracker counted two heartbeats.

scenes.narration: At 5:12 in the morning my fitness tracker counted two heartbeats.
I was lying alone in bed. One steady pulse, mine. And beside it a second line on the graph. Slower. Heavier.
I counted them against each other. I held my breath to hear. My own heart pounded. And from somewhere very close, a second beat answered. Half a second behind.
The tracker buzzed. Resting heart rate, forty. Is this you? I do not own a heart that slow.
I pulled the covers down. Nothing. Just the mattress, and the pale grey dawn at the window.
But the graph kept drawing. The second line was moving. It was not beside me anymore. It was climbing, slowly, up my side of the bed.
The tracker buzzed one last time. Two people detected. Please confirm which one is the sleeper. My thumb hovered. Because the second heartbeat had just got faster, as if it was afraid of the answer.
So tell me. Do you tap me, or tap it?
